statement: Blind annotation from the Beinecke scan alone (full page and four full-resolution strips). The page has four rows, each with a red two-tier cylindrical jar at the left margin followed by detached plant parts, nearly all roots, and a block of text. Row 1: 12 roots (9 hanging in an upper line, 3 lying lower); row 2: 7 roots; row 3: 6 roots and one root with green leaves; row 4: one whole plant. 31 objects. Labels were assigned from line ids, unit codes and line lengths only, assuming the ids run left to right and upper line before lower line; the words were not read from the transcription. Uncertain assignments: row 1 lower labels f99r.12-14 (each lies between an upper and a lower object); f99r.6-7 taken as the single two-line label; f99r.26 and f99r.34 are extra labels beside objects that already carry one (rows 2 and 3 have 8 labels for 7 objects), so their object is ambiguous. The green patch in row 1 is a hole showing the leaf behind, not a drawing.
